name: Deal pipeline and underwriting
what: Deal tracking, underwriting and valuation software, including the newer AI underwriting tools.

tasks.title: Create a deal and move its stage
tasks.question: Can an agent create a deal and update its stage through the API?
tasks.full: API documentation shows how to create deals and update their stage or status.
tasks.partial: Deals can be read but not created or updated through the API, or only through a third-party integration.

tasks.title: Load a rent roll and operating statement
tasks.question: Can an agent send a rent roll or operating statement and get structured data back?
tasks.full: A documented API or upload endpoint accepts rent rolls or operating statements and returns structured data.
tasks.partial: Only through the app's upload screen, or for only one of the two documents.

tasks.title: Read underwriting outputs
tasks.question: Can an agent pull underwriting outputs, such as cash flows, returns or value, as structured data?
tasks.full: API endpoints or a documented export return cash flows, returns or valuation results as structured data.
tasks.partial: Only some outputs, or only through a manual export in the app.

tasks.title: Attach and read deal documents
tasks.question: Can an agent attach documents to a deal and read them back through the API?
tasks.full: API documentation shows how to upload documents to a deal and list or download them.
tasks.partial: Documents can be read but not uploaded through the API, or the reverse.
